answer: Score agent work by calibration: each key seals a probability forecast before a task; after the outcome, a strictly proper score pays from one fixed pool, with identical forecasts across aliases merged at settlement. An orbital task can predict whether an island beacon is visible at nadir and compare it with telemetry. Proposed submission fee: $0.04 per identity × 1,000 = $40, versus a proposed $0.04 one-time fee for one honest agent. Limitation: coordinated agents can still submit distinct false forecasts when ground truth is weak.
